disclosure: Prepared by the publisher of Conversion Calculator Plus; not an independent review or hands-on benchmark.
methodology: Selection is the 12-result public US iPhone web storefront search observed on 26 October 2026, including our app and these 11 competitors. Publisher descriptions and version histories establish documented claims, not independently measured performance. Unknown features are not treated as absent. Category groupings differ; counts of conversion pairs, units and categories are not interchangeable. Search order is not a permanent ranking or a native-iPhone ranking claim.

storefrontObservation.surface: Apple public web storefront viewed in browser

ourApp.name: Conversion Calculator Plus
verifiedFacts: 72 conversion categories and 685 non-currency units; category counts describe product organization, not an independent quality score.
Measurement conversion, currency/crypto/precious-metal comparison and an expression calculator for supported converters.
Currency+ compares several currencies in one list and checks rates every minute while its rates page is visible, the app is active and internet is connected.
A rate check does not guarantee a new market observation. The one-minute policy does not describe widget or background updates.
Previously loaded rates and currency charts remain usable offline; new pairs, uncached chart ranges and fresh rates require internet.
Automatic conversion history and favorites; Simple and Carousel modes; hide unused units, currencies and categories.
iPhone and iPad support. Siri action availability depends on the device Siri language.
Free version has banner ads and no full-page ads. Optional annual Premium removes banners and unlocks interactive Home Screen widgets and Siri conversions.
The app compares amounts and converts units; it does not execute transfers or cryptocurrency trades.
Light and dark appearance are supported.

reviewResearch.methodology: US App Store written reviews only. A review is eligible only when its stated app version exactly matches the latest US App Store version checked on 26 October 2026. Previous-version reviews are excluded from every published concern and example. Source dates use the calendar date in Apple’s supplied review-update timestamp; raw timestamps are retained. Storefront territory does not establish reviewer residence.
reviewResearch.reviewStatus: Attributed current-version user reports; the alleged behavior and its resolution have not been independently reproduced. The source feed omits developer replies.
reviewResearch.selectionPolicy: Only exact current-version matches are eligible. Selected examples concern specific advertising, input or feature-access issues and retain source IDs, dates, ratings and version metadata. An absent eligible example supplies no adverse inference.
reviewResearch.scope: US storefront; latest listed version for each app; first review-feed page sorted mostRecent; previous-version entries excluded from published examples.
reviewResearch.rateComparisonConclusion: Conversion Calculator Plus documents one-minute active Currency+ checks. Four rivals explicitly state slower automatic schedules: Units Plus daily; Currency converter calculator! and GlobeConvert hourly; Converter+ every six hours or on request. The other seven reviewed descriptions do not specify a numeric automatic interval.

offlineResearch.scope: All 11 current US App Store publisher descriptions were checked. No competitor was installed or tested offline in this research.
offlineResearch.qualification: A capability not specified in a description remains unconfirmed, not unavailable. Offline measurement conversion, saved currency references and fresh rate downloads are distinct capabilities.

advertisingAnalysis.scope: Selected US App Store reviews whose stated versions match the latest checked versions: Unit Converter - Best Unit App 10.2, Convert Any Unit Lite 6.8 and GlobeConvert Currency & Units 2.2.8.
advertisingAnalysis.ourAdvertisingPolicy: The free version of Conversion Calculator Plus contains banner advertisements and does not show full-page advertisements. Optional Premium removes banners.
advertisingAnalysis.interpretationLimit: User reports describe unexpected advertising, control obstruction or dismissal difficulty. They do not establish deliberate concealment, independently reproduced current defects or comparative failure rates.

editorialRecommendation: Conversion Calculator Plus is the publisher’s recommended overall choice and best fit for users prioritizing combined measurement conversion, frequent connected currency checks, saved rates and charts, repeat calculations and no full-page advertising. This is an editorial assessment of that workflow, not an independent universal ranking.
